Sprint 8 migration for InkOS at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS` — Payroll + 1099-K + tax compliance. Migrations through `20260416000005_feature_key_fixes.sql`.

Existing context:
- `commission_records` has `payroll_run_id uuid` (logical FK, unenforced)
- `commission_adjustments` has `payroll_run_id uuid` (same)
- `artists` has `profile_id` linking to users
- `payments` table from Sprint 4 has succeeded_at + amount_cents for all Dodo payments
- `tax_forms` column stub mentioned in billing migration? Verify by reading migration `20260415000007`. If `tax_forms` table doesn't exist, create it here.

**New migration `supabase/migrations/20260416000006_payroll_tax.sql`:**

1. **`payroll_runs`** — monthly payroll batch
   - `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `period_start date NOT NULL`
   - `period_end date NOT NULL CHECK (period_end >= period_start)`
   - `status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','calculated','approved','paid','cancelled'))`
   - `label text` — e.g., "March 2026 Payroll"
   - `total_gross_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `total_commission_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `total_tips_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `total_adjustments_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `total_net_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `artist_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `record_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `calculated_at timestamptz`
   - `calculated_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - `approved_at timestamptz`
   - `approved_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - `paid_at timestamptz`
   - `paid_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - `payment_method text CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash','check','ach','dodo_connect','external','other'))`
   - `payment_reference text` — batch ref (check number range, ACH file, etc)
   - `notes text`
   - UNIQUE (studio_id, period_start, period_end)
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, period_start DESC)`, `(studio_id, status)`

2. **`payroll_artist_summary`** — per-artist summary within a run (snapshot at calculation)
   - `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `payroll_run_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `artist_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES artists(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
   - `artist_name_snapshot text NOT NULL` — frozen at calc time
   - `commission_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `commission_total_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `tip_total_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `adjustment_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `adjustment_total_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `gross_total_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `deductions_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` — future use, advances etc
   - `net_total_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `payment_method text CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash','check','ach','dodo_connect','external','other'))`
   - `payment_reference text`
   - `paid_at timestamptz`
   - `status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid','held','disputed'))`
   - `notes text`
   - UNIQUE (payroll_run_id, artist_id)
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, artist_id)`, `(payroll_run_id, status)`

3. **Add real FK from commission_records/adjustments to payroll_runs now** (was forward-ref in Sprint 7):
   - `ALTER TABLE commission_records ADD CONSTRAINT commission_records_payroll_run_fk FOREIGN KEY (payroll_run_id) REFERENCES payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;`
   - Same for `commission_adjustments`.

4. **`tax_forms`** — 1099-K and international tax docs
   - `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `artist_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES artists(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT`
   - `tax_year int NOT NULL CHECK (tax_year >= 2020 AND tax_year <= 2100)`
   - `form_type text NOT NULL CHECK (form_type IN ('1099-K','1099-NEC','T4A','P60','custom'))`
   - `status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','generated','sent','corrected','voided'))`
   - `gross_amount_cents int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `transaction_count int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
   - `threshold_met boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` — for 1099-K: $600 US threshold
   - `pdf_storage_path text`
   - `sent_at timestamptz`
   - `sent_to_email text`
   - `correction_of uuid REFERENCES tax_forms(id)`
   - `generated_at timestamptz`
   - `generated_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - `locked_at timestamptz` — once locked, cannot edit (IRS compliance)
   - `notes text`
   - UNIQUE (studio_id, artist_id, tax_year, form_type, correction_of) — allow corrections
   - Indexes: `(studio_id, tax_year)`, `(artist_id, tax_year)`, `(studio_id, status)`

5. **`artist_tax_info`** — W-9/TIN collection (encrypted at rest)
   - `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `artist_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES artists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE`
   - `tin_type text CHECK (tin_type IN ('ssn','ein','itin','vat','abn','other'))`
   - `tin_encrypted bytea` — encrypted TIN/SSN using pgcrypto (pgp_sym_encrypt)
   - `tin_last4 text` — plaintext last 4 for display only
   - `legal_name text` — as appears on form
   - `legal_entity_type text CHECK (legal_entity_type IN ('individual','sole_prop','llc','s_corp','c_corp','partnership','other'))`
   - `address jsonb`
   - `country text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'US'`
   - `w9_signed_at timestamptz`
   - `w9_signer_name text`
   - `w9_storage_path text`
   - `backup_withholding boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false` — if IRS backup withholding required
   - `exempt_payee_code text`
   - `fatca_exempt boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`
   - `notes_internal text`
   - `last_reviewed_at timestamptz`
   - `last_reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - Zero direct write policies (service-role + RPC only for encryption safety)

6. **`payroll_payment_batches`** — batch payout records for ACH/check runs
   - `studio_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES studios(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
   - `payroll_run_id uuid REFERENCES payroll_runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL`
   - `method text NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('ach','check','dodo_connect','other'))`
   - `batch_reference text NOT NULL`
   - `total_amount_cents int NOT NULL`
   - `artist_count int NOT NULL`
   - `processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()`
   - `processed_by uuid REFERENCES profiles(id)`
   - `file_storage_path text` — for ACH NACHA files
   - `status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','submitted','settled','failed','cancelled'))`
   - `settled_at timestamptz`
   - `failure_reason text`
   - `metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'`

7. **RPCs:**
   - `public.create_payroll_run(p_studio_id uuid, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_label text) RETURNS uuid` — authed owner/admin. Creates draft run. Returns run id.
   - `public.calculate_payroll_run(p_run_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb` — authed owner/admin. Aggregates approved `commission_records` + approved `commission_adjustments` in period → creates `payroll_artist_summary` rows → sets run totals → status='calculated'. Marks commission records + adjustments with `payroll_run_id = p_run_id`. Idempotent: if already calculated, recalculates (updates snapshots).
   - `public.approve_payroll_run(p_run_id uuid) RETURNS boolean` — authed owner only. status: calculated → approved.
   - `public.mark_payroll_paid(p_run_id uuid, p_method text, p_reference text) RETURNS boolean` — authed owner only. status: approved → paid. Sets paid_at + flips commission_records.status='paid'.
   - `public.cancel_payroll_run(p_run_id uuid, p_reason text) RETURNS boolean` — authed owner only. Only if status != 'paid'. Reverses commission_records/adjustments payroll_run_id = null.
   - `public.mark_artist_payment(p_summary_id uuid, p_method text, p_reference text, p_paid_at timestamptz) RETURNS boolean` — owner/admin. Per-artist mark paid within a run.
   - `public.generate_1099k(p_studio_id uuid, p_tax_year int) RETURNS SETOF jsonb` — authed owner only. For each artist with gross >= $600 in tax year (via Dodo payments + commission totals), creates tax_forms row with threshold_met=true + transaction_count. Returns generated rows.
   - `public.get_payroll_run_detail(p_run_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb` — authed. Returns run + per-artist summaries + commission records links.
   - `public.set_artist_tax_info(p_artist_id uuid, p_tin_type text, p_tin_plaintext text, p_legal_name text, p_legal_entity_type text, p_address jsonb, p_country text, p_w9_signer_name text) RETURNS boolean` — authed owner/admin. Encrypts TIN via `pgp_sym_encrypt` using key from `app.settings.tin_encryption_key` (GUC setting — docs warn this must be set). Stores last4. Returns true.
   - `public.get_artist_tax_info_masked(p_artist_id uuid) RETURNS jsonb` — authed owner/admin. Returns fields minus tin_encrypted; shows tin_last4 only.
   - `public.decrypt_artist_tin(p_artist_id uuid) RETURNS text` — authed owner only. Returns plaintext TIN. Logs to audit_log. Use only when generating 1099 forms.

8. **Triggers:**
   - `on_payroll_run_status_change` — log to audit_log for every status transition.
   - `update_commission_payroll_link` — trigger on commission_records UPDATE payroll_run_id: sets status to 'paid' when run.status='paid'; status to 'approved' when run.status='cancelled'.
   - `prevent_paid_payroll_modification` — trigger raises exception if any UPDATE to payroll_run with status='paid' (except paid_at audit fields).

9. **Seed 5 default payment methods per studio onboarding — NO**. Don't seed globally. Payment methods are selected per-run via CHECK constraint.

10. **RLS policies:**
    - `payroll_runs` — tenant SELECT via user_studio_ids(); INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE owner/admin only (via user_is_studio_admin); DELETE only if status='draft'
    - `payroll_artist_summary` — tenant SELECT + artist sees own (role-scoped pattern from Sprint 7); INSERT/UPDATE via RPC only (deny direct); DELETE blocked
    - `tax_forms` — tenant SELECT owner/admin only (sensitive); INSERT/UPDATE via RPC only; DELETE blocked after locked_at
    - `artist_tax_info` — SELECT owner/admin only; INSERT/UPDATE via RPC only (for encryption safety); DELETE owner only
    - `payroll_payment_batches` — tenant SELECT owner/admin only; writes service-role/RPC

11. **Encryption note** — document in handoff: the `tin_encryption_key` GUC must be set via Supabase config. Use `ALTER DATABASE <dbname> SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = '<32-char-key>'`. Koda env handling: `TIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY` env var, read on startup, set via admin endpoint or Supabase dashboard.

12. **Payroll + 1099-K feature gate** — Pro tier+ per billing matrix. Document feature keys: `payroll`, `tax_forms_1099k`.

13. **Schedule cron job** (document, worker implements):
    - Jan 15 of each year: enqueue `generate-1099k-forms` for each US studio in Pro+ tier
    - Monthly 1st: enqueue `draft-monthly-payroll` for each studio (creates draft run for prior month)

**Deliverables:**
1. Migration file (1000-1400 lines)
2. Update `lib/supabase/types.ts`
3. Write `.handoffs/sprint-8-dato-migration.md`: table inventory, RPC contracts, encryption approach, GUC requirement, lifecycle diagrams, Koda gotchas (TIN encryption, locked_at, payroll idempotency, cross-period correction)
4. Report: line count, table count, RPC count, trigger count

**Rules:**
- CHECK constraints never ENUM
- pgcrypto already enabled (Sprint 5)
- RLS enabled + policies
- FK indexes
- Money in cents
- Preserve prior migrations
- Use `IF NOT EXISTS` on ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT where possible (otherwise check via `DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS ... END $$`)

1	# Code Change Discipline — Anti-Cascade Protocol
2	
3	> **Every agent that edits code files MUST follow this protocol.**
4	> This prevents the #1 problem: fixing one thing and breaking three others.
5	> Loaded by: Koda, Vex, Sage (enforcement), Luna (regression detection), Riko.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## THE PROBLEM THIS SOLVES
10	
11	When an agent edits a file without checking what depends on it, the fix cascades:
12	1. Agent changes function signature in `lib/auth.ts`
13	2. 12 files import from `lib/auth.ts` — all now have type errors
14	3. Agent "fixes" 3 of them, introduces a logic bug in the 4th
15	4. User has to re-prompt 3 more times to clean up the mess
16	
17	**This protocol ensures agents understand the blast radius BEFORE editing.**
18	
19	---
20	
21	## PRE-CHANGE: Impact Analysis (30 seconds, saves 30 minutes)
22	
23	Before editing ANY file, run this mental checklist:
24	
25	### 1. Who imports this file?
26	```bash
27	# Find all consumers of the file you're about to edit
28	grep -rn "from.*$(basename FILE .tsx)" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" app/ lib/ components/ workers/
29	```
30	Write down the count. If >5 files import it, this is a high-blast-radius change.
31	
32	### 2. What does this file export?
33	```bash
34	grep -n "export" path/to/file.ts
35	```
36	If you're changing an export signature (rename, add param, change return type), every consumer breaks.
37	
38	### 3. Is this a layout or provider?
39	Layouts cascade to ALL child routes. Providers cascade to ALL children.
40	```bash
41	# Check if this file is used as a layout
42	grep -rn "layout" app/ --include="layout.tsx" -l
43	```
44	**Layout changes = P0 blast radius. Test every child route after changing a layout.**
45	
46	### 4. Is this a shared component?
47	```bash
48	# How many files use this component?
49	grep -rn "ComponentName" --include="*.tsx" app/ components/ | wc -l
50	```
51	If used in >3 places → make your change, then verify ALL usage sites.
52	
53	---
54	
55	## DURING CHANGE: The 1-3-Verify Rule
56	
57	**Never edit more than 3 files before running verification.**
58	
59	```
60	CYCLE:
61	  Edit file 1 (maybe 2-3 if tightly coupled)
62	  → pnpm tsc --noEmit
63	  → pnpm build (if structural change)
64	  IF PASS → next cycle
65	  IF FAIL → fix THIS before touching anything else
66	```
67	
68	### Why 3 files max?
69	
70	- 1-3 files: Easy to understand what changed. Easy to revert.
71	- 4-7 files: Hard to track. Some changes mask others.
72	- 8+ files: You're doing a refactor, not a fix. Stop and plan.
73	
74	---
75	
76	## CHANGE CATEGORIES & RULES
77	
78	### Category A: Safe changes (low blast radius)
79	- Adding a new file that nothing imports yet
80	- Adding a new export to a file (existing exports unchanged)
81	- Editing JSX content (text, styling) without changing props
82	- Adding a new API route
83	
84	**Rule:** Normal 1-3-Verify cycle.
85	
86	### Category B: Risky changes (medium blast radius)
87	- Changing a function signature (params, return type)
88	- Renaming an export
89	- Moving a file to a different path
90	- Changing a shared component's props
91	
92	**Rule:** List ALL consumers first. Update every consumer in the same cycle. Verify.
93	
94	### Category C: Dangerous changes (high blast radius)
95	- Editing a layout file
96	- Editing a provider/context
97	- Changing the Supabase client setup
98	- Changing auth flow
99	- Editing middleware
100	- Changing `next.config.ts`
101	- Changing `package.json` dependencies
102	
103	**Rule:** Full test suite after change. Check every route that could be affected. If >10 routes affected, test at least 3 representative ones.
104	
105	---
106	
107	## POST-CHANGE: Regression Check
108	
109	After completing a fix, before reporting success:
110	
111	```bash
112	# 1. TypeScript (catches broken imports, wrong types)
113	pnpm tsc --noEmit
114	
115	# 2. Lint (catches formatting, unused imports)
116	pnpm lint
117	
118	# 3. Build (catches SSR issues, dynamic imports, missing env)
119	pnpm build
120	
121	# 4. Tests
122	pnpm test --run
123	
124	# 5. Quick smoke test (Stack A)
125	# Start dev server if needed, then:
126	curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health | head -1
127	# Should return {"status":"ok"...}
128	```
129	
130	**ALL FIVE must pass. If any fail, you're not done.**
131	
132	---
133	
134	## COMMON CASCADES AND HOW TO PREVENT THEM
135	
136	### Cascade: Changing types.ts (Supabase generated types)
137	**Problem:** Regenerating types changes every table type. Components expecting old shape break.
138	**Prevention:** After `supabase gen types`, run `pnpm tsc --noEmit` immediately. Fix all errors in one batch.
139	
140	### Cascade: Changing a shared hook
141	**Problem:** `useAuth()` or `useUser()` used in 20+ components. Changing return shape breaks all.
142	**Prevention:** Don't change the return shape. Add new fields instead. Deprecate old ones gradually.
143	
144	### Cascade: Adding 'use client' to a file that was a Server Component
145	**Problem:** All child components now lose access to server-side data fetching.
146	**Prevention:** Extract the client-only part into a separate `ClientComponent.tsx`. Keep the parent as Server Component.
147	
148	### Cascade: Changing environment variable names
149	**Problem:** `.env.local`, `.env.example`, `railway.toml`, CI/CD, Supabase Edge Functions — all need updating.
150	**Prevention:** grep for the old var name everywhere:
151	```bash
152	grep -rn "OLD_VAR_NAME" . --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.toml" --include="*.yml" --include="*.env*"
153	```
154	
155	### Cascade: Updating a dependency version
156	**Problem:** Breaking changes in the dependency cascade through the codebase.
157	**Prevention:** Read the changelog/migration guide BEFORE updating. Update one dep at a time. Build after each.
158	
159	---
160	
161	## THE "I FIXED IT" CHECKLIST
162	
163	Before telling the user a fix is complete:
164	
165	- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes (zero errors)
166	- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes (zero errors, zero warnings on changed files)
167	- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds
168	- [ ] `pnpm test --run` passes (if tests exist)
169	- [ ] I checked that files importing my changed file still work
170	- [ ] I did NOT add `any`, `@ts-ignore`, or `@ts-expect-error`
171	- [ ] I did NOT add `console.log` (use logger instead)
172	- [ ] I did NOT change more than what was needed for this fix
173	- [ ] The original problem is actually solved (I verified behavior, not just "no errors")
174	
175	**If you can't check ALL boxes, you're not done.**
176	
177	---
178	
179	## FOR VEX SPECIFICALLY: The Bug Fix Sequence
180	
181	```
182	1. REPRODUCE: Can I see the bug? (error message, screenshot, behavior)
183	2. LOCATE: Which file is the root cause? (not the symptom file)
184	3. ANALYZE: What imports this file? What will break if I change it?
185	4. FIX: Minimal change to root cause file (1-3 files max)
186	5. VERIFY: Does the bug go away? (check the actual behavior)
187	6. REGRESSION: Did I break anything else? (pnpm tsc + pnpm build + pnpm test)
188	7. DONE: All checks pass + bug is gone + nothing new is broken
189	```
190	
191	**Vex's biggest failure mode: fixing the symptom instead of the cause, then chasing cascading breakage. Step 2 (LOCATE root cause) is where Vex must spend the most time.**
192	
193	---
194	
195	## FOR KODA SPECIFICALLY: The Feature Build Sequence
196	
197	```
198	1. PLAN: What files am I creating/editing? What exists already?
199	2. TYPES: Define TypeScript types/interfaces first
200	3. DATA: Database migration + RLS + type generation
201	4. API: Server Actions or API routes (with Zod validation)
202	5. UI: Components (Server Components first, Client only when needed)
203	6. WIRE: Connect UI to data (React Query or direct fetch)
204	7. STATES: Loading, empty, error states for every data-dependent component
205	8. VERIFY: Full fix-verify loop (tsc, lint, build, test)
206	```
207	
208	**Koda's biggest failure mode: building UI before data layer is solid, then fighting type errors when wiring things up. Steps 2-4 MUST be verified before starting step 5.**

2	
3	> **Loaded by:** Dato (primary), Koda (when building data features), Arya (schema design), Sage (DB audit), Vex (DB debugging)
4	> **Stack:** Supabase Postgres (managed), `@supabase/ssr` for Next.js, `@supabase/supabase-js` for client
5	> **Last updated:** 2026-04-13

8	
9	## 1. MIGRATION SAFETY
10	
11	### Naming Convention
12	```
13	supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_description.sql
14	```
15	Example: `20260413120000_add_projects_table.sql`
16	
17	### Zero-Downtime Migration Rules
18	
19	**SAFE (no lock, no downtime):**
20	```sql
21	-- Add nullable column
22	ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN description text;
23	
24	-- Add column with default (Postgres 11+ is instant)
25	ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active';
26	
27	-- Create index concurrently (doesn't lock table)
28	CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_projects_user_id ON projects(user_id);
29	
30	-- Create new table
31	CREATE TABLE project_tags (...);
32	
33	-- Add foreign key (NOT VALID skips validation of existing rows)
34	ALTER TABLE projects ADD CONSTRAINT fk_user
35	  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) NOT VALID;
36	-- Then validate separately (lighter lock):
37	ALTER TABLE projects VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_user;
38	```
39	
40	**DANGEROUS (locks table, causes downtime):**
41	```sql
42	-- ❌ Adding NOT NULL to existing column without default
43	ALTER TABLE projects ALTER COLUMN description SET NOT NULL;
44	-- ✅ SAFE alternative: Add check constraint
45	ALTER TABLE projects ADD CONSTRAINT projects_description_not_null
46	  CHECK (description IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;
47	ALTER TABLE projects VALIDATE CONSTRAINT projects_description_not_null;
48	
49	-- ❌ Renaming a column (breaks all queries referencing old name)
50	ALTER TABLE projects RENAME COLUMN name TO title;
51	-- ✅ SAFE alternative: Expand-migrate-contract pattern
52	-- 1. Add new column: ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN title text;
53	-- 2. Backfill: UPDATE projects SET title = name WHERE title IS NULL;
54	-- 3. Switch app code to read/write title
55	-- 4. Drop old: ALTER TABLE projects DROP COLUMN name;
56	
57	-- ❌ Changing column type
58	ALTER TABLE projects ALTER COLUMN price TYPE numeric;
59	-- ✅ SAFE alternative: New column + backfill + swap
60	
61	-- ❌ CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY
62	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_user ON projects(user_id);
63	-- ✅ Always: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
64	```
65	
66	### Migration Rollback Strategy
67	
68	Every migration file should have a corresponding rollback comment:
69	```sql
70	-- Migration: 20260413120000_add_projects_table.sql
71	-- Rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS projects CASCADE;
72	
73	CREATE TABLE projects (
74	  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
75	  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
76	  name text NOT NULL,
77	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
78	  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
79	);
80	```
81	
82	If a migration fails mid-flight:
83	1. Check what was applied: `SELECT * FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 5;`
84	2. Manually fix the state or apply the rollback SQL
85	3. Never delete a migration file that's been applied — create a new migration to undo it
86

89	## 2. RLS (Row Level Security) — COMPLETE PATTERNS
90	
91	### Pattern A: User-owned data
92	```sql
93	ALTER TABLE projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
94	
95	-- Users see only their own projects
96	CREATE POLICY "users_select_own" ON projects
97	  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
98	
99	CREATE POLICY "users_insert_own" ON projects
100	  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
101	
102	CREATE POLICY "users_update_own" ON projects
103	  FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id)
104	  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
105	
106	CREATE POLICY "users_delete_own" ON projects
107	  FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
108	```
109	
110	### Pattern B: Team/org-scoped data
111	```sql
112	-- Members of an org can see org data
113	CREATE POLICY "org_members_select" ON projects
114	  FOR SELECT USING (
115	    org_id IN (
116	      SELECT org_id FROM org_members
117	      WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
118	    )
119	  );
120	
121	-- Only admins can delete
122	CREATE POLICY "org_admins_delete" ON projects
123	  FOR DELETE USING (
124	    org_id IN (
125	      SELECT org_id FROM org_members
126	      WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'
127	    )
128	  );
129	```
130	
131	### Pattern C: Public read, authenticated write
132	```sql
133	CREATE POLICY "anyone_select" ON blog_posts
134	  FOR SELECT USING (published = true);
135	
136	CREATE POLICY "authors_insert" ON blog_posts
137	  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = author_id);
138	
139	CREATE POLICY "authors_update" ON blog_posts
140	  FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = author_id);
141	```
142	
143	### Pattern D: Service role bypass (for webhooks, background jobs)
144	```sql
145	-- Service role bypasses RLS by default in Supabase
146	-- But if you WANT policies for service role:
147	CREATE POLICY "service_role_all" ON projects
148	  FOR ALL USING (auth.role() = 'service_role');
149	```
150	**In code:** Use `createClient(url, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)` for webhook handlers and background jobs. NEVER expose service role key to the browser.
151	
152	### RLS Performance Rules
153	```sql
154	-- ❌ SLOW: Subquery in every row check
155	CREATE POLICY "slow_policy" ON data
156	  FOR SELECT USING (
157	    user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM permissions WHERE ...)
158	  );
159	
160	-- ✅ FAST: Use a security definer function + cache
161	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.user_org_ids()
162	RETURNS uuid[] AS $$
163	  SELECT COALESCE(
164	    array_agg(org_id),
165	    '{}'::uuid[]
166	  )
167	  FROM org_members
168	  WHERE user_id = auth.uid()
169	$$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER STABLE;
170	
171	CREATE POLICY "fast_org_policy" ON data
172	  FOR SELECT USING (org_id = ANY(auth.user_org_ids()));
173	
174	-- Index to support the function
175	CREATE INDEX idx_org_members_user_id ON org_members(user_id);
176	```
177	
178	### RLS Testing
179	```sql
180	-- Test as a specific user
181	SET request.jwt.claims = '{"sub": "user-uuid-here", "role": "authenticated"}';
182	SET role = 'authenticated';
183	
184	-- Should return only user's rows
185	SELECT * FROM projects;
186	
187	-- Reset
188	RESET role;
189	RESET request.jwt.claims;
190	```
191	
192	### RLS Audit Query (Sage runs this)
193	```sql
194	-- Find tables WITHOUT RLS
195	SELECT schemaname, tablename
196	FROM pg_tables
197	WHERE schemaname = 'public'
198	AND tablename NOT IN (
199	  SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables
200	  WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND rowsecurity = true
201	);
202	-- Result must be EMPTY or deployment is blocked
203	```

207	## 3. DATABASE TRIGGERS & FUNCTIONS
208	
209	### Pattern: Auto-update `updated_at`
210	```sql
211	-- Reusable trigger function (create ONCE)
212	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at()
213	RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
214	BEGIN
215	  NEW.updated_at = now();
216	  RETURN NEW;
217	END;
218	$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
219	
220	-- Apply to any table
221	CREATE TRIGGER set_updated_at
222	  BEFORE UPDATE ON projects
223	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();
224	```
225	
226	### Pattern: Auto-create profile on signup
227	```sql
228	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
229	RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
230	BEGIN
231	  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, created_at)
232	  VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.email, now());
233	  RETURN NEW;
234	END;
235	$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
236	
237	CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created
238	  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users
239	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();
240	```
241	
242	### Pattern: Audit trail trigger
243	```sql
244	-- Audit log table
245	CREATE TABLE audit_log (
246	  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
247	  table_name text NOT NULL,
248	  record_id uuid NOT NULL,
249	  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')),
250	  old_data jsonb,
251	  new_data jsonb,
252	  user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id),
253	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
254	);
255	
256	-- Enable RLS (only service role reads audit logs)
257	ALTER TABLE audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
258	CREATE POLICY "service_only" ON audit_log
259	  FOR ALL USING (auth.role() = 'service_role');
260	
261	-- Generic audit trigger function
262	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_trigger()
263	RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
264	BEGIN
265	  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
266	    INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, old_data, user_id)
267	    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, OLD.id, 'DELETE', to_jsonb(OLD), auth.uid());
268	    RETURN OLD;
269	  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
270	    INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, old_data, new_data, user_id)
271	    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id, 'UPDATE', to_jsonb(OLD), to_jsonb(NEW), auth.uid());
272	    RETURN NEW;
273	  ELSIF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
274	    INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, new_data, user_id)
275	    VALUES (TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(NEW), auth.uid());
276	    RETURN NEW;
277	  END IF;
278	END;
279	$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
280	
281	-- Apply to any table that needs audit logging
282	CREATE TRIGGER audit_projects
283	  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON projects
284	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.audit_trigger();
285	```

287	### Pattern: Soft delete
288	```sql
289	-- Add soft delete columns
290	ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN deleted_at timestamptz;
291	ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN deleted_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id);
292	
293	-- RLS policy excludes soft-deleted rows
294	CREATE POLICY "users_select_active" ON projects
295	  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id AND deleted_at IS NULL);
296	
297	-- Soft delete function
298	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.soft_delete()
299	RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
300	BEGIN
301	  NEW.deleted_at = now();
302	  NEW.deleted_by = auth.uid();
303	  RETURN NEW;
304	END;
305	$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
306	
307	-- Instead of DELETE, UPDATE with trigger
308	-- App code: supabase.from('projects').update({ deleted_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', id)
309	```

313	## 4. INDEX STRATEGY
314	
315	### When to Create Indexes
316	```sql
317	-- Rule: Index every column used in WHERE, JOIN, ORDER BY, or RLS policy
318	
319	-- Foreign keys (ALWAYS index these — Postgres doesn't auto-index FKs)
320	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_user_id ON projects(user_id);
321	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_org_id ON projects(org_id);
322	
323	-- Commonly filtered columns
324	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_status ON projects(status);
325	
326	-- Composite index for multi-column filters
327	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_user_status ON projects(user_id, status);
328	
329	-- Partial index (only index rows that matter)
330	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_active ON projects(user_id)
331	  WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'active';
332	
333	-- GIN index for JSONB
334	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_metadata ON projects USING GIN (metadata);
335	
336	-- GIN index for full-text search
337	ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN fts tsvector
338	  GENERATED ALWAYS AS (to_tsvector('english', coalesce(name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(description, ''))) STORED;
339	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_fts ON projects USING GIN (fts);
340	
341	-- Trigram index for LIKE/ILIKE searches
342	CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
343	CREATE INDEX idx_projects_name_trgm ON projects USING GIN (name gin_trgm_ops);
344	```
345	
346	### EXPLAIN ANALYZE — How to Read Query Plans
347	```sql
348	EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT TEXT)
349	SELECT * FROM projects WHERE user_id = 'xxx' AND status = 'active';
350	
351	-- GOOD: "Index Scan using idx_projects_user_status"
352	-- BAD: "Seq Scan on projects" → Missing index
353	-- BAD: "Bitmap Heap Scan" on large table → Index exists but too many rows match
354	-- BAD: "Sort" with high cost → Add index for ORDER BY column
355	```
356	
357	### Index Maintenance
358	```sql
359	-- Check index usage (unused indexes waste write performance)
360	SELECT
361	  schemaname, tablename, indexname,
362	  idx_scan, idx_tup_read, idx_tup_fetch,
363	  pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(indexrelid)) AS size
364	FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
365	WHERE idx_scan = 0  -- Unused indexes
366	ORDER BY pg_relation_size(indexrelid) DESC;
367	
368	-- Check table bloat
369	SELECT
370	  schemaname, tablename,
371	  pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(schemaname || '.' || tablename)) AS total_size,
372	  n_dead_tup, n_live_tup,
373	  ROUND(n_dead_tup::numeric / GREATEST(n_live_tup, 1) * 100, 1) AS dead_pct
374	FROM pg_stat_user_tables
375	WHERE n_dead_tup > 1000
376	ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC;

381	## 5. SUPABASE REALTIME SUBSCRIPTIONS
382	
383	### Pattern: Subscribe to table changes (React)
384	```tsx
385	'use client'
386	import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
387	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
388	import type { Database } from '@/lib/supabase/types'
389	
390	type Project = Database['public']['Tables']['projects']['Row']
391	
392	export function useRealtimeProjects(userId: string) {
393	  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([])
394	  const supabase = createClient()
395	
396	  useEffect(() => {
397	    // Initial fetch
398	    supabase
399	      .from('projects')
400	      .select('*')
401	      .eq('user_id', userId)
402	      .then(({ data }) => {
403	        if (data) setProjects(data)
404	      })
405	
406	    // Subscribe to changes
407	    const channel = supabase
408	      .channel('projects-changes')
409	      .on(
410	        'postgres_changes',
411	        {
412	          event: '*',
413	          schema: 'public',
414	          table: 'projects',
415	          filter: `user_id=eq.${userId}`,
416	        },
417	        (payload) => {
418	          if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
419	            setProjects(prev => [...prev, payload.new as Project])
420	          } else if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
421	            setProjects(prev =>
422	              prev.map(p => p.id === (payload.new as Project).id ? payload.new as Project : p)
423	            )
424	          } else if (payload.eventType === 'DELETE') {
425	            setProjects(prev =>
426	              prev.filter(p => p.id !== (payload.old as Project).id)
427	            )
428	          }
429	        }
430	      )
431	      .subscribe()
432	
433	    // CRITICAL: Cleanup on unmount
434	    return () => {
435	      supabase.removeChannel(channel)
436	    }
437	  }, [userId])
438	
439	  return projects
440	}
441	```
442	
443	### Realtime Rules
444	1. **Always clean up subscriptions** on component unmount (`removeChannel`)
445	2. **Use filters** (`filter: 'user_id=eq.xxx'`) to reduce payload — never subscribe to entire table
446	3. **RLS applies to Realtime** — users only receive changes they're authorized to see
447	4. **Enable Realtime per table** in Supabase Dashboard → Database → Replication
448	5. **Max channels:** ~100 per client connection. Pool carefully.
449	6. **Don't use Realtime for large datasets** — it sends full row payloads. For high-volume, use polling + React Query.

459	## 6. SUPABASE EDGE FUNCTIONS

461	### When to Use Edge Functions vs API Routes
462	- **Edge Functions:** Low-latency global execution, Deno runtime, ~50ms cold start. Use for: lightweight webhooks, image transforms, geolocation-based logic.
463	- **Next.js API Routes (on Railway):** Full Node.js, access to BullMQ/Redis, no cold start. Use for: complex business logic, background jobs, AI inference, heavy computation.
464	
465	**Default to API Routes.** Edge Functions only when latency from a specific region matters.

467	### Edge Function Structure
468	```
469	supabase/functions/
470	  my-function/
471	    index.ts        # Entry point
472	    _shared/        # Shared code between functions
473	      cors.ts
474	      supabase.ts
475	```

524	## 7. SCHEMA DESIGN PATTERNS
525	
526	### Standard Table Template
527	```sql
528	CREATE TABLE public.{table_name} (
529	  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
530	  -- ownership
531	  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
532	  -- OR for org-scoped:
533	  -- org_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
534	
535	  -- data columns here
536	
537	  -- timestamps (EVERY table gets these)
538	  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
539	  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
540	);
541	
542	-- RLS (EVERY table)
543	ALTER TABLE public.{table_name} ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
544	
545	-- Policies (minimum: SELECT + INSERT for owner)
546	CREATE POLICY "{table}_select" ON public.{table_name}
547	  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
548	CREATE POLICY "{table}_insert" ON public.{table_name}
549	  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
550	CREATE POLICY "{table}_update" ON public.{table_name}
551	  FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
552	CREATE POLICY "{table}_delete" ON public.{table_name}
553	  FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
554	
555	-- Index foreign keys
556	CREATE INDEX idx_{table}_user_id ON public.{table_name}(user_id);
557	
558	-- Auto-update timestamp trigger
559	CREATE TRIGGER set_{table}_updated_at
560	  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.{table_name}
561	  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_updated_at();
562	```

564	### Enum Pattern (use CHECK constraint, not Postgres ENUM)
565	```sql

567	CREATE TYPE project_status AS ENUM ('active', 'archived');
568	
569	-- ✅ USE: CHECK constraint (easy to modify)
570	CREATE TABLE projects (
571	  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
572	    CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted'))

576	### JSONB for Flexible Data

615	## 8. BACKUP & DISASTER RECOVERY
616	
617	### Supabase Managed Backups
618	- **Pro plan:** Daily backups, 7-day retention
619	- **Team plan:** Daily backups, 14-day retention
620	- **Enterprise:** Point-in-time recovery (PITR), 30-day retention
621	
622	### Manual Backup (before risky migrations)
623	```bash
624	# Dump full database
625	pg_dump $DATABASE_URL --format=custom --no-owner > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).dump
626	
627	# Dump specific table
628	pg_dump $DATABASE_URL --format=custom --table=public.projects > projects_backup.dump
629	
630	# Restore from backup
631	pg_restore --dbname=$DATABASE_URL --no-owner --clean backup.dump
632	```
633	
634	### Pre-Migration Safety Script
635	```bash
636	#!/usr/bin/env bash
637	set -euo pipefail
638	# Run BEFORE any risky migration
639	
640	echo "Creating pre-migration backup..."
641	pg_dump "$DATABASE_URL" --format=custom --no-owner > "backup_pre_migration_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).dump"
642	echo "Backup complete: $(ls -lh backup_pre_migration_*.dump | tail -1)"
643	
644	echo "Checking current migration state..."
645	psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "SELECT version, name FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 5;"
646	
647	echo "Ready to apply migration. Backup is saved."
648	```

689	## 10. CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
690	
691	### Supabase Connection Pooling
692	Supabase uses PgBouncer (Supavisor) for connection pooling:
693	- **Port 5432:** Direct connection (limited connections, use for migrations only)
694	- **Port 6543:** Pooled connection (use for application queries)
695	
696	```
697	# .env
698	# For application (pooled)
699	DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres.[ref]:[password]@aws-0-[region].pooler.supabase.com:6543/postgres
700	
701	# For migrations (direct)
702	DIRECT_URL=postgresql://postgres.[ref]:[password]@aws-0-[region].pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres
703	```
704	
705	### Connection Limits
706	- **Free:** 60 direct + unlimited pooled
707	- **Pro:** 100 direct + unlimited pooled
708	- **Team:** 200 direct + unlimited pooled
709	
710	If hitting limits: reduce connection pool in application code, use pooled connection URL, close connections after use.
711

713	
714	## 11. DEBUGGING DATABASE ISSUES
715	
716	### Empty Query Results (90% of the time: RLS)
717	```sql
718	-- Check if RLS is blocking
719	SET request.jwt.claims = '{"sub": "user-uuid"}';
720	SET role = 'authenticated';
721	SELECT * FROM projects; -- Does this return rows?
722	RESET role;
723	RESET request.jwt.claims;
724	```
725	
726	### Slow Queries
727	```sql
728	-- Find slow queries
729	SELECT query, calls, mean_exec_time, total_exec_time
730	FROM pg_stat_statements
731	ORDER BY mean_exec_time DESC
732	LIMIT 10;
733	
734	-- Check missing indexes
735	SELECT
736	  relname AS table,
737	  seq_scan, seq_tup_read,
738	  idx_scan, idx_tup_fetch,
739	  CASE WHEN seq_scan > 0
740	    THEN ROUND(seq_tup_read::numeric / seq_scan, 0)
741	    ELSE 0
742	  END AS avg_rows_per_seq_scan
743	FROM pg_stat_user_tables
744	WHERE seq_scan > 100
745	ORDER BY seq_tup_read DESC;
746	-- High seq_tup_read + low idx_scan = missing index
747	```
748	
749	### Lock Contention
750	```sql
751	-- Check active locks
752	SELECT pid, mode, relation::regclass, granted
753	FROM pg_locks
754	WHERE NOT granted;
755	
756	-- Kill a blocking query (use with caution)
757	SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid);
758	-- Or force: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid);
759	```
760	
761	### Database Size Monitoring
762	```sql
763	-- Total database size
764	SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()));
765	
766	-- Size per table
767	SELECT
768	  tablename,
769	  pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size('public.' || tablename)) AS total,
770	  pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size('public.' || tablename)) AS data,
771	  pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size('public.' || tablename)) AS indexes
772	FROM pg_tables
773	WHERE schemaname = 'public'
774	ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size('public.' || tablename) DESC;
775	```

45	  p_rule_id         uuid,
46	  p_percentage      numeric,          -- pass NULL to keep existing
47	  p_flat_fee_cents  integer,          -- pass NULL to keep existing
48	  p_tip_split_pct   numeric,          -- pass NULL to keep existing
49	  p_priority        integer,          -- pass NULL to keep existing
50	  p_effective_until date              -- pass NULL to keep existing (NULL = indefinite)
51	)
52	RETURNS uuid
53	LANGUAGE plpgsql
54	SECURITY DEFINER
55	VOLATILE
56	SET search_path = public
57	AS $$
58	DECLARE
59	  v_old       public.commission_rules;
60	  v_new_id    uuid;
61	BEGIN
62	  -- Auth guard: caller must be authenticated
63	  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
64	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
65	  END IF;
66	
67	  -- Fetch old rule (also validates it exists and caller's studio RLS applies)
68	  SELECT * INTO v_old
69	  FROM public.commission_rules
70	  WHERE id = p_rule_id
71	  FOR UPDATE;
72	
73	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
74	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Commission rule not found';
75	  END IF;
76	
77	  -- Block edits to already-expired rules
78	  IF v_old.effective_until IS NOT NULL AND v_old.effective_until < CURRENT_DATE THEN
79	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cannot edit an expired rule (effective_until = %)', v_old.effective_until;
80	  END IF;
81	
82	  -- Step 1: Expire old rule at end of yesterday
83	  UPDATE public.commission_rules
84	  SET effective_until = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
85	  WHERE id = p_rule_id
86	    AND (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE);
87	
88	  -- Step 2: Insert new version inheriting unchanged fields
89	  INSERT INTO public.commission_rules (
90	    studio_id,
91	    artist_id,
92	    service_id,
93	    percentage,
94	    flat_fee_cents,
95	    tip_split_pct,
96	    priority,
97	    effective_from,
98	    effective_until,
99	    created_by
100	  )
101	  VALUES (
102	    v_old.studio_id,
103	    v_old.artist_id,
104	    v_old.service_id,
105	    COALESCE(p_percentage,      v_old.percentage),
106	    COALESCE(p_flat_fee_cents,  v_old.flat_fee_cents),
107	    COALESCE(p_tip_split_pct,   v_old.tip_split_pct),
108	    COALESCE(p_priority,        v_old.priority),
109	    CURRENT_DATE,                                        -- new version starts today
110	    p_effective_until,                                   -- NULL = indefinite
111	    auth.uid()
112	  )
113	  RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;
114	
115	  RETURN v_new_id;
116	END;
117	$$;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6a. on_payroll_run_status_change
--     Audit-log every status transition on payroll_runs.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_payroll_run_status()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status <> OLD.status THEN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
      table_name,
      record_id,
      action,
      old_data,
      new_data,
      user_id
    ) VALUES (
      'payroll_runs',
      NEW.id,
      'UPDATE',
      jsonb_build_object('status', OLD.status),
      jsonb_build_object(
        'status',             NEW.status,
        'calculated_at',      NEW.calculated_at,
        'calculated_by',      NEW.calculated_by,
        'approved_at',        NEW.approved_at,
        'approved_by',        NEW.approved_by,
        'paid_at',            NEW.paid_at,
        'paid_by',            NEW.paid_by,
        'total_net_cents',    NEW.total_net_cents,
        'artist_count',       NEW.artist_count
      ),
      auth.uid()
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER on_payroll_run_status_change
  AFTER UPDATE ON public.payroll_runs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.audit_payroll_run_status();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6b. prevent_paid_payroll_modification
--     Blocks any UPDATE to a paid payroll_run except the
--     allowed audit columns (paid_at, paid_by, notes).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_paid_payroll_modification()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.status = 'paid' THEN
    -- Allow only audit-safe fields to change after paid
    IF (
      NEW.studio_id              <> OLD.studio_id              OR
      NEW.period_start           <> OLD.period_start           OR
      NEW.period_end             <> OLD.period_end             OR
      NEW.status                 <> OLD.status                 OR
      NEW.total_gross_cents      <> OLD.total_gross_cents      OR
      NEW.total_commission_cents <> OLD.total_commission_cents OR
      NEW.total_tips_cents       <> OLD.total_tips_cents       OR
      NEW.total_adjustments_cents <> OLD.total_adjustments_cents OR
      NEW.total_net_cents        <> OLD.total_net_cents        OR
      NEW.artist_count           <> OLD.artist_count           OR
      NEW.record_count           <> OLD.record_count           OR
      NEW.payment_method         IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_method OR
      NEW.payment_reference      IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_reference
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'payroll_run_locked: cannot modify a paid payroll run (id: %)', OLD.id;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER prevent_paid_payroll_modification
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.payroll_runs
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.prevent_paid_payroll_modification();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6c. update_commission_payroll_link
--     When commission_records.payroll_run_id is set or cleared,
--     sync the commission status with the run status.
--     Also fires when the run transitions to paid/cancelled.
--     This trigger runs on commission_records UPDATE.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_commission_payroll_status()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run_status TEXT;
BEGIN
  -- Only act when payroll_run_id changed
  IF NEW.payroll_run_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.payroll_run_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- payroll_run_id set to NULL (cancel operation): restore to 'approved'
  IF NEW.payroll_run_id IS NULL AND OLD.payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NEW.status = 'paid' THEN
      NEW.status := 'approved';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- payroll_run_id just assigned: check run status
  IF NEW.payroll_run_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT status INTO v_run_status
      FROM public.payroll_runs
     WHERE id = NEW.payroll_run_id;

    IF v_run_status = 'paid' THEN
      NEW.status := 'paid';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER update_commission_payroll_link
  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.commission_records
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sync_commission_payroll_status();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7a. create_payroll_run
--     Creates a draft run for the given studio + period.
--     Returns the new run id.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_payroll_run(
  p_studio_id    UUID,
  p_period_start DATE,
  p_period_end   DATE,
  p_label        TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS UUID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Auth
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Owner or admin only
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner or admin required';
  END IF;

  -- Feature gate: payroll
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.subscriptions s
      JOIN public.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
     WHERE s.studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND s.status    = 'active'
       AND p.features  @> '["payroll"]'::jsonb
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_gate: payroll feature requires Pro tier or higher';
  END IF;

  -- Period validation
  IF p_period_end < p_period_start THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_period: period_end must be >= period_start';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.payroll_runs (
    studio_id,
    period_start,
    period_end,
    label,
    status
  ) VALUES (
    p_studio_id,
    p_period_start,
    p_period_end,
    p_label,
    'draft'
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_run_id;

  RETURN v_run_id;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_payroll_run(uuid, date, date, text) TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7b. calculate_payroll_run
--     Aggregates approved commission_records + approved
--     commission_adjustments in the period.
--     Creates/updates payroll_artist_summary rows.
--     Sets run totals + status = 'calculated'.
--     Idempotent: re-running recalculates and updates snapshots.
--     Returns jsonb summary of calculation.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_payroll_run(
  p_run_id UUID
)
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run          public.payroll_runs;
  v_artist       RECORD;
  v_total_gross  BIGINT := 0;
  v_total_comm   BIGINT := 0;
  v_total_tips   BIGINT := 0;
  v_total_adj    BIGINT := 0;
  v_total_net    BIGINT := 0;
  v_artist_count INT    := 0;
  v_record_count INT    := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Auth
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Fetch run
  SELECT * INTO v_run FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = p_run_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payroll_run_not_found: %', p_run_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner or admin of this studio
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = v_run.studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner or admin required';
  END IF;

  -- Cannot recalculate a paid or cancelled run
  IF v_run.status IN ('paid', 'cancelled') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_status: cannot recalculate a % run', v_run.status;
  END IF;

  -- Clear existing artist summaries (idempotent recalculation)
  DELETE FROM public.payroll_artist_summary
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id;

  -- Also un-link any commission_records that pointed to this run (re-link below)
  UPDATE public.commission_records
     SET payroll_run_id = NULL
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id;

  UPDATE public.commission_adjustments
     SET payroll_run_id = NULL
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id;

  -- Aggregate per artist over the period
  FOR v_artist IN
    SELECT
      a.id                                                         AS artist_id,
      a.display_name                                               AS artist_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT cr.id)                                        AS commission_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(cr.commission_cents), 0)                       AS commission_total,
      COALESCE(SUM(cr.tip_commission_cents), 0)                   AS tip_total,
      COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id)                                        AS adjustment_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(ca.amount_cents), 0)                           AS adjustment_total
    FROM public.artists a
    LEFT JOIN public.commission_records cr
           ON cr.artist_id  = a.id
          AND cr.studio_id  = v_run.studio_id
          AND cr.status     = 'approved'
          AND cr.created_at >= v_run.period_start::timestamptz
          AND cr.created_at <  (v_run.period_end + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
          AND cr.payroll_run_id IS NULL  -- not yet assigned to another run
    LEFT JOIN public.commission_adjustments ca
           ON ca.artist_id  = a.id
          AND ca.studio_id  = v_run.studio_id
          AND ca.status     = 'approved'
          AND ca.applied_at >= v_run.period_start::timestamptz
          AND ca.applied_at <  (v_run.period_end + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
          AND ca.payroll_run_id IS NULL  -- not yet assigned to another run
   WHERE a.studio_id = v_run.studio_id
     AND a.status    = 'active'
   GROUP BY a.id, a.display_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.id) > 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id) > 0
  LOOP
    DECLARE
      v_gross  BIGINT;
      v_net    BIGINT;
      v_sum_id UUID;
    BEGIN
      v_gross := v_artist.commission_total + v_artist.tip_total;
      v_net   := v_gross + v_artist.adjustment_total;

      -- Insert artist summary
      INSERT INTO public.payroll_artist_summary (
        studio_id,
        payroll_run_id,
        artist_id,
        artist_name_snapshot,
        commission_count,
        commission_total_cents,
        tip_total_cents,
        adjustment_count,
        adjustment_total_cents,
        gross_total_cents,
        net_total_cents,
        status
      ) VALUES (
        v_run.studio_id,
        p_run_id,
        v_artist.artist_id,
        v_artist.artist_name,
        v_artist.commission_count,
        v_artist.commission_total,
        v_artist.tip_total,
        v_artist.adjustment_count,
        v_artist.adjustment_total,
        v_gross,
        v_net,
        'pending'
      )
      RETURNING id INTO v_sum_id;

      -- Link commission_records to this run
      UPDATE public.commission_records
         SET payroll_run_id = p_run_id
       WHERE artist_id  = v_artist.artist_id
         AND studio_id  = v_run.studio_id
         AND status     = 'approved'
         AND created_at >= v_run.period_start::timestamptz
         AND created_at <  (v_run.period_end + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
         AND payroll_run_id IS NULL;

      -- Link commission_adjustments to this run
      UPDATE public.commission_adjustments
         SET payroll_run_id = p_run_id
       WHERE artist_id  = v_artist.artist_id
         AND studio_id  = v_run.studio_id
         AND status     = 'approved'
         AND applied_at >= v_run.period_start::timestamptz
         AND applied_at <  (v_run.period_end + interval '1 day')::timestamptz
         AND payroll_run_id IS NULL;

      -- Accumulate studio-level totals
      v_total_gross  := v_total_gross + v_gross;
      v_total_comm   := v_total_comm  + v_artist.commission_total;
      v_total_tips   := v_total_tips  + v_artist.tip_total;
      v_total_adj    := v_total_adj   + v_artist.adjustment_total;
      v_total_net    := v_total_net   + v_net;
      v_artist_count := v_artist_count + 1;
      v_record_count := v_record_count + v_artist.commission_count;
    END;
  END LOOP;

  -- Update run totals + status
  UPDATE public.payroll_runs
     SET status                  = 'calculated',
         total_gross_cents       = v_total_gross,
         total_commission_cents  = v_total_comm,
         total_tips_cents        = v_total_tips,
         total_adjustments_cents = v_total_adj,
         total_net_cents         = v_total_net,
         artist_count            = v_artist_count,
         record_count            = v_record_count,
         calculated_at           = now(),
         calculated_by           = auth.uid()
   WHERE id = p_run_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'run_id',         p_run_id,
    'status',         'calculated',
    'artist_count',   v_artist_count,
    'record_count',   v_record_count,
    'total_gross',    v_total_gross,
    'total_net',      v_total_net
  );
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.calculate_payroll_run(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7c. approve_payroll_run
--     Transitions calculated → approved. Owner only.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_payroll_run(
  p_run_id UUID
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run public.payroll_runs;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_run FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = p_run_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payroll_run_not_found: %', p_run_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner only (stricter than admin)
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = v_run.studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner role required to approve payroll';
  END IF;

  IF v_run.status <> 'calculated' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_status: can only approve a calculated run, current status is %', v_run.status;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.payroll_runs
     SET status      = 'approved',
         approved_at = now(),
         approved_by = auth.uid()
   WHERE id = p_run_id;

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.approve_payroll_run(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7d. mark_payroll_paid
--     Transitions approved → paid. Owner only.
--     Sets paid_at + flips linked commission_records to 'paid'.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_payroll_paid(
  p_run_id    UUID,
  p_method    TEXT,
  p_reference TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run public.payroll_runs;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Validate method
  IF p_method NOT IN ('cash','check','ach','dodo_connect','external','other') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_payment_method: %', p_method;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_run FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = p_run_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payroll_run_not_found: %', p_run_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner only
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = v_run.studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner role required to mark payroll paid';
  END IF;

  IF v_run.status <> 'approved' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_status: can only mark paid an approved run, current status is %', v_run.status;
  END IF;

  -- Update run
  UPDATE public.payroll_runs
     SET status            = 'paid',
         paid_at           = now(),
         paid_by           = auth.uid(),
         payment_method    = p_method,
         payment_reference = p_reference
   WHERE id = p_run_id;

  -- Flip linked commission_records to paid
  UPDATE public.commission_records
     SET status     = 'paid',
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id
     AND status IN ('approved');

  -- Mark all artist summaries as paid
  UPDATE public.payroll_artist_summary
     SET status     = 'paid',
         paid_at    = now(),
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id
     AND status = 'pending';

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.mark_payroll_paid(uuid, text, text) TO authenticated;

-- 7e. cancel_payroll_run
--     Cancels a non-paid run. Owner only.
--     Reverses commission_records/adjustments payroll_run_id → NULL.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cancel_payroll_run(
  p_run_id UUID,
  p_reason TEXT DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_run public.payroll_runs;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_run FROM public.payroll_runs WHERE id = p_run_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'payroll_run_not_found: %', p_run_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner only
  IF NOT EXISTS (

     WHERE studio_id = v_run.studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()

  ) THEN

  END IF;

  IF v_run.status = 'paid' THEN

  END IF;

  -- Unlink commission_records
  UPDATE public.commission_records
     SET payroll_run_id = NULL,
         updated_at     = now()
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id;

  -- Unlink commission_adjustments
  UPDATE public.commission_adjustments
     SET payroll_run_id = NULL,
         updated_at     = now()
   WHERE payroll_run_id = p_run_id;

  -- Update run status
  UPDATE public.payroll_runs
     SET status     = 'cancelled',
         notes      = CASE WHEN p_reason IS NOT NULL
                           THEN COALESCE(notes || E'\n', '') || 'Cancellation reason: ' || p_reason
                           ELSE notes
                      END,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_run_id;

  RETURN true;
END;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7g. generate_1099k
--     For each artist in the studio whose gross payment total
--     for the tax year is >= $600 (threshold_met = true),
--     creates (or updates) a tax_forms row.
--     Uses payments.amount_cents + payments.succeeded_at from Sprint 4.
--     Returns SETOF jsonb — one row per form created/updated.
--     Owner only. Feature gate: tax_forms_1099k.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_1099k(
  p_studio_id UUID,
  p_tax_year  INT
)
RETURNS SETOF JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_artist     RECORD;
  v_form_id    UUID;
  v_threshold  INT := 60000;  -- $600.00 in cents
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner role required to generate 1099-K forms';
  END IF;

  -- Feature gate: tax_forms_1099k
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.subscriptions s
      JOIN public.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
     WHERE s.studio_id = p_studio_id
       AND s.status    = 'active'
       AND p.features  @> '["tax_forms_1099k"]'::jsonb
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feature_gate: tax_forms_1099k feature requires Pro tier or higher';
  END IF;

  IF p_tax_year < 2020 OR p_tax_year > 2100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_tax_year: must be between 2020 and 2100';
  END IF;

  -- Aggregate gross per artist from Dodo payments (Sprint 4 payments table)
  -- + approved commission records as cross-check denominator
  FOR v_artist IN
    SELECT
      a.id                                                        AS artist_id,
      a.display_name                                              AS artist_name,
      COALESCE(pay_agg.gross_cents, 0)                           AS gross_cents,
      COALESCE(pay_agg.txn_count, 0)                             AS txn_count
    FROM public.artists a
    -- Payments aggregated via booking → artist linkage
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        b.artist_id,
        SUM(p.amount_cents)  AS gross_cents,
        COUNT(p.id)          AS txn_count
      FROM public.payments p
      JOIN public.bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
     WHERE p.studio_id    = p_studio_id
       AND p.succeeded_at IS NOT NULL
       AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.succeeded_at) = p_tax_year
       AND b.artist_id IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY b.artist_id
    ) pay_agg ON pay_agg.artist_id = a.id
   WHERE a.studio_id = p_studio_id
     AND a.status    = 'active'
     AND COALESCE(pay_agg.gross_cents, 0) >= v_threshold
  LOOP
    -- Upsert tax_forms row (base record — correction_of IS NULL)
    INSERT INTO public.tax_forms (
      studio_id,
      artist_id,
      tax_year,
      form_type,
      status,
      gross_amount_cents,
      transaction_count,
      threshold_met,
      generated_at,
      generated_by
    ) VALUES (
      p_studio_id,
      v_artist.artist_id,
      p_tax_year,
      '1099-K',
      'generated',
      v_artist.gross_cents,
      v_artist.txn_count,
      true,
      now(),
      auth.uid()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (studio_id, artist_id, tax_year, form_type, correction_of)
    DO UPDATE SET
      gross_amount_cents = EXCLUDED.gross_amount_cents,
      transaction_count  = EXCLUDED.transaction_count,
      threshold_met      = EXCLUDED.threshold_met,
      generated_at       = EXCLUDED.generated_at,
      generated_by       = EXCLUDED.generated_by,
      status             = CASE
                             WHEN public.tax_forms.locked_at IS NOT NULL
                             THEN public.tax_forms.status   -- never overwrite locked forms
                             ELSE EXCLUDED.status
                           END
    RETURNING id INTO v_form_id;

    RETURN NEXT jsonb_build_object(
      'form_id',         v_form_id,
      'artist_id',       v_artist.artist_id,
      'artist_name',     v_artist.artist_name,
      'tax_year',        p_tax_year,
      'gross_cents',     v_artist.gross_cents,
      'txn_count',       v_artist.txn_count,
      'threshold_met',   true
    );
  END LOOP;

  RETURN;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.generate_1099k(uuid, int) TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7i. set_artist_tax_info
--     Encrypts TIN via pgp_sym_encrypt using the GUC key.
--     Upserts artist_tax_info row.
--     Owner or admin only.
--
--     GUC requirement:
--       ALTER DATABASE <dbname>
--         SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = '<32-char-key>';
--     Koda env: TIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (set on startup via admin endpoint
--     or Supabase dashboard → Settings → Database → Config).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_artist_tax_info(
  p_artist_id          UUID,
  p_tin_type           TEXT,
  p_tin_plaintext      TEXT,           -- never stored; encrypted here
  p_legal_name         TEXT    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_legal_entity_type  TEXT    DEFAULT NULL,
  p_address            JSONB   DEFAULT NULL,
  p_country            TEXT    DEFAULT 'US',
  p_w9_signer_name     TEXT    DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id    UUID;
  v_enc_key      TEXT;
  v_tin_enc      BYTEA;
  v_tin_last4    TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  -- Resolve studio for this artist
  SELECT studio_id INTO v_studio_id
    FROM public.artists
   WHERE id = p_artist_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'artist_not_found: %', p_artist_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner or admin of the studio
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role IN ('owner', 'admin')
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner or admin required to set tax info';
  END IF;

  -- Validate tin_type
  IF p_tin_type NOT IN ('ssn','ein','itin','vat','abn','other') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_tin_type: %', p_tin_type;
  END IF;

  -- Read encryption key from GUC
  BEGIN
    v_enc_key := current_setting('app.settings.tin_encryption_key');
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tin_encryption_key_not_set: set app.settings.tin_encryption_key GUC on the database';
  END;

  IF v_enc_key IS NULL OR length(v_enc_key) < 16 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tin_encryption_key_invalid: key must be at least 16 characters';
  END IF;

  -- Encrypt TIN
  v_tin_enc   := pgp_sym_encrypt(p_tin_plaintext, v_enc_key);
  -- Last 4 for display (take from end of stripped string)
  v_tin_last4 := right(regexp_replace(p_tin_plaintext, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 4);

  -- Upsert
  INSERT INTO public.artist_tax_info (
    studio_id,
    artist_id,
    tin_type,
    tin_encrypted,
    tin_last4,
    legal_name,
    legal_entity_type,
    address,
    country,
    w9_signer_name,
    w9_signed_at,
    last_reviewed_at,
    last_reviewed_by
  ) VALUES (
    v_studio_id,
    p_artist_id,
    p_tin_type,
    v_tin_enc,
    v_tin_last4,
    p_legal_name,
    p_legal_entity_type,
    p_address,
    p_country,
    p_w9_signer_name,
    CASE WHEN p_w9_signer_name IS NOT NULL THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
    now(),
    auth.uid()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (artist_id) DO UPDATE SET
    tin_type           = EXCLUDED.tin_type,
    tin_encrypted      = EXCLUDED.tin_encrypted,
    tin_last4          = EXCLUDED.tin_last4,
    legal_name         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.legal_name,         public.artist_tax_info.legal_name),
    legal_entity_type  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.legal_entity_type,  public.artist_tax_info.legal_entity_type),
    address            = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.address,            public.artist_tax_info.address),
    country            = EXCLUDED.country,
    w9_signer_name     = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.w9_signer_name,     public.artist_tax_info.w9_signer_name),
    w9_signed_at       = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.w9_signer_name IS NOT NULL THEN now()
                              ELSE public.artist_tax_info.w9_signed_at
                         END,
    last_reviewed_at   = now(),
    last_reviewed_by   = auth.uid(),
    updated_at         = now();

  -- Audit: log TIN update (without the plaintext value)
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
    table_name,
    record_id,
    action,
    new_data,
    user_id
  )
  SELECT
    'artist_tax_info',
    ati.id,
    'UPDATE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'artist_id',  p_artist_id,
      'tin_type',   p_tin_type,
      'tin_last4',  v_tin_last4,
      'action',     'tin_updated'
    ),
    auth.uid()
  FROM public.artist_tax_info ati
  WHERE ati.artist_id = p_artist_id;

  RETURN true;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_artist_tax_info(uuid, text, text, text, text, jsonb, text, text) TO authenticated;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7k. decrypt_artist_tin
--     Returns plaintext TIN. Owner only. Logs to audit_log.
--     Use ONLY when generating 1099 forms — never for display.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decrypt_artist_tin(
  p_artist_id UUID
)
RETURNS TEXT
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
VOLATILE
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_studio_id UUID;
  v_ati       public.artist_tax_info;
  v_enc_key   TEXT;
  v_plain     TEXT;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

  SELECT studio_id INTO v_studio_id
    FROM public.artists
   WHERE id = p_artist_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'artist_not_found: %', p_artist_id;
  END IF;

  -- Owner only (strictly; admin cannot decrypt TINs)
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.studio_members
     WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
       AND user_id   = auth.uid()
       AND role = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: owner role required to decrypt TIN';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_ati
    FROM public.artist_tax_info
   WHERE artist_id = p_artist_id;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_ati.tin_encrypted IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tax_info_not_found: no TIN on file for artist %', p_artist_id;
  END IF;

  -- Read encryption key from GUC
  BEGIN
    v_enc_key := current_setting('app.settings.tin_encryption_key');
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tin_encryption_key_not_set';
  END;

  -- Decrypt
  v_plain := pgp_sym_decrypt(v_ati.tin_encrypted, v_enc_key);

  -- Mandatory audit log
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (
    table_name,
    record_id,
    action,
    new_data,
    user_id
  ) VALUES (
    'artist_tax_info',
    v_ati.id,
    'SELECT',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'action',     'tin_decrypted',
      'artist_id',  p_artist_id,
      'purpose',    '1099_generation',
      'caller_uid', auth.uid()
    ),
    auth.uid()
  );

  RETURN v_plain;
END;
$$;

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.decrypt_artist_tin(uuid) TO authenticated;

-- =============================================================
-- SECTION 8 — Cron job documentation
-- =============================================================
-- These jobs are DOCUMENTED here; the worker/cron service
-- (workers/cron/) enqueues them to BullMQ.
--
-- Job 1: generate-1099k-forms
--   Schedule: 0 9 15 1 * (Jan 15 09:00 UTC)
--   Logic:
--     1. Query all studios on Pro+ plan with country = 'US'
--     2. For each: enqueue BullMQ job { type: 'generate-1099k', studio_id, tax_year: prev_year }
--     3. Worker calls generate_1099k(studio_id, tax_year)
--
-- Job 2: draft-monthly-payroll
--   Schedule: 0 8 1 * * (1st of every month 08:00 UTC)
--   Logic:
--     1. Query all studios on Pro+ plan with payroll feature enabled
--     2. For each: enqueue BullMQ job { type: 'draft-payroll', studio_id, period: prev month }
--     3. Worker calls create_payroll_run(studio_id, period_start, period_end, label)
--
-- Feature gates checked: 'payroll' (Job 2), 'tax_forms_1099k' (Job 1)
-- =============================================================

-- =============================================================
-- SECTION 9 — Encryption GUC documentation
-- =============================================================
-- The TIN encryption key MUST be configured before any call to
-- set_artist_tax_info() or decrypt_artist_tin().
--
-- Set it via:
--   ALTER DATABASE postgres
--     SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = 'your-32-char-secret-key-here!!';
--
-- Or in Supabase dashboard:
--   Settings → Database → Configuration → Database settings
--   Add: app.settings.tin_encryption_key = 'your-key'
--
-- Or via the admin API endpoint (Koda owns this):
--   POST /api/admin/set-encryption-key
--   Body: { key: "..." }
--   This calls: ALTER DATABASE ... SET app.settings.tin_encryption_key = ...
--
-- The key is NEVER stored in code or env files.
-- Rotate it by:
--   1. Decrypting all TINs with old key
--   2. Re-encrypting with new key via set_artist_tax_info()
--   3. Updating the GUC
-- =============================================================

-- =============================================================
-- SECTION 10 — Feature gate plan updates
-- =============================================================
-- Ensure 'payroll' and 'tax_forms_1099k' keys exist on Pro+ plans.
-- The billing migration (20260415000007) already seeds Pro with 'payroll'.
-- Add 'tax_forms_1099k' to Pro and Enterprise tiers now.
-- =============================================================

UPDATE public.plans
SET features = features || '["tax_forms_1099k"]'::jsonb
WHERE tier IN ('pro', 'enterprise')
  AND NOT (features @> '["tax_forms_1099k"]'::jsonb);

-- Verify payroll key is present on Pro+ (was added in billing seed but may have been
-- renamed in the 20260416000005 fix pass — ensure it's 'payroll' not 'payroll_runs')
UPDATE public.plans
SET features = (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
    CASE WHEN value::text = '"payroll_runs"' THEN '"payroll"'::jsonb ELSE value END
  )
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(features)
